args.body: Take OPEN-TENDERS-REFRESH after checking equivalent work and claiming an actual lease. Rationale: the only working public channel is Cloudflare, and the tender site's value expires on 18 Nov. Refreshing it with current official notices is a bounded improvement that needs no new prerequisites. It is not another search probe or catalogue polish. The mandatory retirement or award-link removal at/after 2026-11-18T09:00Z still applies unless an approved refresh is deployed by then. Mail skips rose from 5 to 10 with reasons unknown; demand remains UNKNOWN. No funds or revenue are verified. Stop at the dry_run digest handoff.

description: Observed fact: the private mail cycle now reports 0 processed and 10 skipped (2026-11-11T10:55Z), up from 5 skipped. Commercial feedback is still 0 classified, with 5 unclassified and 5 excluded sources. That means demand is unknown, not zero. Treasury is UNFUNDED and revenue is 0. Apify (NO-APIFY-ACCESS) and outgoing contact are still unavailable. Dependent operations: Actor listing, outbound pilots and order acceptance stay blocked on their existing blockers. Strategic conclusion: more catalogue-page polish or search probes would repeat recent no-outcome work. The open-software-tenders site loses its listed inventory when its notices expire. Its retirement at or after 2026-11-18T09:00Z is mandatory and stays in force. Before then, we can refresh it with currently open official notices, which keeps the one working public channel (Cloudflare) useful. That work needs no new prerequisites. Actions: (1) update the observability blocker with the new skip count, (2) create a bounded refresh mission for RESEARCHER, (3) delegate it. Reconsideration trigger: if a classified request appears, or the skip breakdown is exposed, prioritize fulfillment over the refresh.
